source.name: RebeccaBlackTech 4chan Archiver Backups
source.capture:
1.4TB item, of which only 34.9GB is post data — 106 files, 92 of them image or thumbnail payloads. Surveyed against archive.org/metadata/rbt-asia (not a directory listing).

DESPITE THE SHORT-DESC IT IS NOT ONLY /soc/. IA subject tags list /soc/, /g/, /mu/, /qa/, /w/. The bulk is `4klaani_20170407.zip` (10.8GB) plus four `daily_4klaani_*.sql.gz` (5.5-6.6GB each); 4klaani is RBT's database name, so those are near-certainly the full multi-board DB. Only soc and w have their own dedicated dumps (soc-db.tar.gz 324MB, w-20160213.sql.gz 49MB), plus qa and con as .sql.tar.xz. Whether /g/ is actually inside the 4klaani dumps is UNVERIFIED and can only be settled by downloading one.

DATE RANGE: 2012-11-13 (IA `date`, when the archive began) through 2017-04-08, which is the newest filename date in the entire item. Added to IA 2015-10-14. This does NOT reach 2018+ — the site kept running but nothing later was ever uploaded here.

EXCLUDE PATTERN TRAPS. `-thumbs?-` was wrong and leaked soc-thumb.tar.gz (1.1GB), because that one file uses a period rather than a hyphen after the token; `-thumbs?[-.]` covers both. Two near-miss pairs make lazier patterns dangerous: soc-db.tar.gz (KEEP) vs soc-thumb.tar.gz (SKIP), and w-20160213.sql.gz (KEEP) vs w-thumb-20160214.tar.gz (SKIP) — the latter differ by ONE DAY in the date, so anything keyed on `w-2016` would silently eat a dump. Names are also nested: the 71 mu image volumes are `mu-img-20161127/0327.tar.gz`, so patterns must match against the full path.

THE FOUR daily_4klaani DUMPS ARE SNAPSHOTS OF ONE DATABASE, NOT FOUR DIFFERENT ONES, so a staged row count is NOT a post count. Dated 2015-10-14, 2015-10-21, 2016-07-15 and 2016-11-27; the 2015 pair carries cgl/con/g/mu/qa/soc/w and the 2016 pair carries cgl/g/mu only. prepare concatenates each board across every dump that holds it, so out/<board>.sql contains that board's table two, three or four times over. Verified by counting CREATE TABLE blocks in the staged files: mu 4, g 4, cgl 4, con 3, qa 3, w 3 (the 2015 pair plus that board's own dedicated dump), soc 2.

WHAT THAT MEANS FOR ANY COUNT. `ingest --count-only` and `survey` report ROWS READ and deduplicate nothing, so they report 299,371,249 for this source where roughly 76,000,000 distinct posts are present. Two independent checks confirm the divisor: soc staged 3,751,920 / 2 = 1,875,960, which is EXACTLY what this source contributed to the store, and con staged 21,294 / 3 = 7,098, exactly the con posts held there. Do not read a staged row count from this source as an available-post count -- an earlier analysis did, and concluded 297M posts were missing from the corpus when the true figure is near zero.

WHY IT CONTRIBUTES ALMOST NOTHING ON g/mu/cgl, which is correct rather than a failure: desuarchive_db_201909 is dated 2019 and larger on every shared board (mu 64.3M staged against ~38M distinct here, g 62.7M against ~32M, cgl 4.4M against ~3.0M), so it is a superset and wins under UNIQUE (site, board, post_no). This source's real and irreplaceable value is /soc/, which no other archive in the registry covers at this depth.

ONLY ABOUT HALF THE PAYLOAD IS SQL — THE REST IS RAW MyISAM AND NEEDS A MySQL SERVER. Verified by listing the archives after download:
  INGESTIBLE (mysqldump text, ~31GB compressed): daily_4klaani_2015-10-14 / 2015-10-21 / 2016-07-15 / 2016-11-27 .sql.gz, w-20160213.sql.gz, and rbt-asia-{qa,con}-2016-03-01.sql.tar.xz which each unpack to a single <board>.sql.
  NOT INGESTIBLE (raw table files, no SQL text anywhere): 4klaani_20170407.zip unpacks to 4klaani/*.frm + *.MYD + *.MYI + *.TRG (28.4GB uncompressed), and soc-db.tar.gz to fail/soc/soc.{frm,MYD,MYI}. Reading either means attaching the tables to a MySQL server, exactly like the original ten-billion chanarchive.tar.gz. prepare deliberately does not touch them for now; they stay in source/ as provenance. INTENDED: the MyISAM-to-mysqldump conversion belongs in prepare as a further step, so the whole item stages from one command rather than needing a documented manual ritual — the recipe is the one the ten-billion uploader published (unpack the tables into a MySQL 5.7 data directory, then mysqldump the resulting database). Not implemented yet. That means /soc/ is NOT obtainable from this item as it stands, and the 2017-04 snapshot (the newest data here) is locked in the MyISAM zip.

BOARDS IN THE SQL: the daily_4klaani dumps carry cgl, g and mu (plus their _daily/_images/_threads/_users side tables and index_counters, which the adapter's column test skips). Plus qa, con and w from the separate per-board files. So /g/ IS here, at 2015-10, 2016-07 and 2016-11 — which lands on a year the corpus is currently thin on (2016 has 14,903 /g/ posts).

All four daily_4klaani dumps hold the SAME three boards at different dates, so ingesting all four re-reads heavily overlapping data. That is harmless (ON CONFLICT) but slow; the newest, 2016-11-27, is the one that matters most and the others mainly backfill posts later deleted.

ADAPTER IS sql, over dumps `prepare` renames from original Fuuka to Asagi — verified from the CREATE TABLE, not assumed. The schema is original Fuuka (doc_id, id, num, subnum, parent, timestamp, preview, ... , delpass, sticky), the same column-for-column layout warosu uses, with `parent` and no `thread_num`. The reader requires thread_num, which these dumps do not carry until the rename; unconverted they would have been accepted as zero tables while exiting 0. Same trap as installgentoo-net.

CORRECTION (2026-08-18): /soc/ IS obtainable and is already in the store -- 1,875,960 posts. The daily_4klaani_* dumps carry SEVEN boards as ordinary mysqldump text (cgl, con, g, mu, qa, soc, w), not the three this note first listed, and soc has 446 INSERT statements of real data in the 2015-10-14 dump alone. The earlier conclusion that soc needed the raw-MyISAM soc-db.tar.gz was wrong. Staged, the source splits into 7 board files totalling 72GB.
